cohort: The study included 738,733 children born between 2011 and 2013 who participated in the Korean National Health Screening Program for Infants and Children (NHSPIC).
finding: Both very preterm (VPT) and moderate-to-late preterm (MLPT) births are significantly associated with an increased risk of neurodevelopmental impairments in young children compared to full-term births.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured for all included children, and low birth weight was identified as a factor associated with increased NI risk.
gest_age: Gestational age was categorized into very preterm, moderate-to-late preterm, and full-term, and was a primary exposure investigated in the study.
